entries.reason: The actor deliberately starts a utility warmup whose lifetime is independent of the foreground caller. The actor owns the Task handle, bounds entries, exposes namespace/global cancellation, removes the entry on completion, and never lets warmup failure alter foreground semantics.

The demonstration URLProtocol is instantiated and called by Foundation across concurrency domains. Its mutable fixture and client-delivery state are serialized by its explicit lock/queue discipline and it is confined to the non-production Workbench example target.
The deterministic test clock is shared by concurrent test operations; its only mutable UInt64 is read and advanced under one NSLock, and the type is private to the test file.
The credential-refresh test clock contains one mutable UInt64 and every read/write is serialized by one NSLock. It exists only to deterministically advance authentication expiry in tests.

The private fake prepared decoder must conform to the Sendable production protocol while exposing deterministic counters to the test. All counter mutation and snapshots are serialized by one NSLock; no real decoder or ImageIO object crosses the boundary.
